'''Field Operations Director''' was a rank used by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] to signify the commanding [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of field operations. [[Korol Tander]] was promoted to the rank of Field Operations Director from [[Bureau Chief]] by the time of the [[Battle of Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''
